title: Mobile race control
trustedLan: Use only on a trusted LAN or with HTTPS. This is not a safety-rated emergency stop.
notConfigured: Mobile race control has not been set up yet.
keyRequiredHint: On: Race control requires the key for network access.
keyDisabledWarning: Off: Anyone on the network can control races without a director key.
keyRequirementError: Could not save the race director key setting.
linkWarning: Anyone with a link may request chaos for that driver. Do not share publicly. Valid for six hours and only while the assignment remains unchanged.
copyLink: Copied if clipboard is available. Otherwise select and copy this link. On other devices use the LAN IP instead of localhost.
setupHere: On the race PC, enter your own key or leave the field empty to generate a secure key automatically. RaceHubOS saves it on the server without a restart.
setupOnRacePc: Initial setup is only available directly on the race PC. Open http://localhost:5173/display/control (development) or http://localhost:3001/display/control there, then refresh this page.
setupSecretHint: Copy this key now and store it securely. You need it to unlock control on a phone. It is saved on the server in packages/backend/.env and will not be shown here again.
vscWarning: The CU receives speed commands; verify physical behavior. Not an emergency stop.
tyreConfirmWarning: CU pit signals are not hardware-verified. Confirm only after personally observing a real pit stop. This changes virtual tyres only.
penaltyHelp: Penalties affect classification, not recorded laps.
damageRepairWarning: CU pit flags have not been hardware verified. The displayed duration is an observed pit interval, not a proven stationary interval. Only confirm after personally verifying a sufficiently long real repair stop.
damageNoPit: No eligible CU pit interval recorded; cannot confirm.
damageVerifyConfirm: Did you personally verify the actual repair stop?
secretRequirements: 32–128 characters: letters, digits, hyphen or underscore. Leave empty to generate a secure key.
changeSecretWarning: Existing driver CHAOS links and previous director QR codes will stop working. Other director devices must unlock again.
secretChanged: Director credential changed. The new key is active immediately.
recoveryOnRacePc: To reset, open this page via localhost directly on the race PC. The previous credential is not required.
recoveryKeepsData: Sessions, drivers and race data are preserved. The new credential takes effect immediately; no restart needed.
recoveryConfirm: I confirm that previous director and driver links will stop working.
recoveryError: Could not reset the director credential. Check server configuration write permissions and try again.
recoveryConfigError: The credential configuration is managed externally or contains conflicting entries. Local recovery was not performed.
sessionRecoveryHelp: Review sessions stored as running and explicitly resolve an orphaned entry. Lap data is preserved. This data repair sends no stop or reset command to the CU.
sessionRecoveryConflict: The assignment or status changed, or another operation is in progress. Refresh the list and review again.
sessionRecoveryError: Could not resolve the entry. Refresh the list; check the server log if the error persists.
sessionRecoverySuccess: “{{name}}” was marked incomplete. All race data is preserved.
sessionRecoveryBoundHelp: The session currently bound to the race PC is protected. Check whether the other entries are orphaned yourself.
sessionRecoveryUnknown: The server has no bound session. After a restart, this does not establish which session was actually running. Review each entry before selecting it.
sessionRecoveryEmpty: No sessions are stored as running.
sessionRecoveryBound: Currently bound to the race PC — cannot be resolved here.
sessionRecoveryConfirm: I verified that “{{name}}” is orphaned. Correct its running status to incomplete and preserve all race data.
sessionRecoveryAudit: Running status manually corrected from “{{status}}” to “Incomplete” on {{date}}. This is not a normal race finish; lap data was preserved.

penaltyServing.noStop: No eligible stop after the penalty was issued
penaltyServing.confirm: I verified at least {{seconds}} seconds stationary to serve this penalty.
penaltyServing.help: Time in the pit lane does not prove stationary time. Confirm only after your own verification. No automatic pit-speed detection. A manual override requires a reason.

featureAccess.title: Driver links, penalties and session recovery
featureAccess.requires: Enter the director credential above to operate these features. They stay visible here while locked.
featureAccess.driverLinks: Select a session and assign drivers, then issue their personal QR links here. Starting fuel and pit strategy are operated on the driver device.
featureAccess.penalties: Select a started race. Time penalties can be confirmed served with verified stationary time or a reasoned manual override.
